entities.summary: Bartolomé Ferrer, also known as Bartolomé Ferrelo, was born in 1499 in the region of Levante, Spain, started his discovery voyages in Nueva Vizcaya, founded by de basc governor Ibarra, and died in 1550 in Mexico.
